title: Refusal classes
$comment: Frozen as schema v1 at T1's gate (PLAN.md section 7), after the contract met live data on 18 and 19 September. Uses the keyword subset implemented by tools/validate.py; an unknown keyword is an error there, never ignored. Every change since 062a245 is listed in schema/CHANGES.md with the case that forced it; a change after the freeze needs a new schema_version and a row there.
description: The closed list of reasons a checker may refuse a certificate bundle. Closed so that two independent checkers refuse the same bundle for the same stated reason: the TypeScript checker in T3 returns these exact classes, and a disagreement between it and the reference refuser is then a real disagreement rather than a wording difference. A checker that cannot place a fault in one of these classes must say ENGINE_DISAGREES rather than invent a class.
